pop = load("svy")["mil"].values
truth = pop.mean()                                   # 4.8913 = 이 세계의 참값

rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
hit = 0
for _ in range(100):                                 # 표본 100개, 구간 100개
    s = rng.choice(pop, size=50, replace=False)
    half = 1.96 * s.std(ddof=1) / np.sqrt(50)        # 11장의 SE 에 1.96 배
    if s.mean() - half <= truth <= s.mean() + half:
        hit += 1
print(hit)
# 96

tg, cg = exp[exp.cond == 1].mil, exp[exp.cond == 0].mil
se = np.sqrt(tg.std(ddof=1)**2 / len(tg) + cg.std(ddof=1)**2 / len(cg))
obs = tg.mean() - cg.mean()
print(round(se, 3), round(obs - 1.96 * se, 2), round(obs + 1.96 * se, 2))
# 0.128 0.03 0.53

def cohen_d(a, b):
    sp = np.sqrt(((len(a)-1)*a.std(ddof=1)**2 + (len(b)-1)*b.std(ddof=1)**2)
                 / (len(a)+len(b)-2))
    return (a.mean() - b.mean()) / sp

print(round(cohen_d(exp[exp.cond==1].mil, exp[exp.cond==0].mil), 2))

for rel in (1.00, 0.90, 0.70):                       # 척도의 신뢰도
    rng = np.random.default_rng(73)
    noise = np.sqrt((1 - rel) / rel) if rel < 1 else 0.0
    hits = 0
    for _ in range(2000):
        a = rng.normal(0.22, 1, 190); b = rng.normal(0, 1, 190)
        if noise:
            a = a + rng.normal(0, noise, 190)        # 측정값 = 참값 + 잡음
            b = b + rng.normal(0, noise, 190)
        hits += stats.ttest_ind(a, b).pvalue < .05
    print(rel, hits / 2000)                      # 2,000번 가운데 잡은 비율
# 1.0 0.5585
# 0.9 0.517
# 0.7 0.415
